title: Visual-evidence gate blocks a no-UI project
context: The completion gate throws PackRegistryEmptyError (paqad's own text: install fault, not a clean change). Cause: .config.app visual_evidence=true + .config.policy visual_evidence_mode=strict, but this plugin has no UI (design-system doc: no visual UI) and the installed paqad runtime ships no frontend stack packs. The TD change itself is verified: 6/6 stages recorded with isolation, 229 tests green, review clean, docs synced.

options.label: Set visual_evidence=false in .config.app for this no-UI project (correct config)
Leave config; treat as paqad install fault and reinstall/doctor paqad-ai yourself

rationale: no-UI plugin; visual gate does not apply
